instructions: Bake sweet potato at 400°F for about 45 minutes until fork-tender (or microwave 8 minutes).
Bake salmon at 400°F for 12-14 minutes until it flakes easily.
Plate with olive oil drizzle and lemon over the salmon.
Serve with Sparkling mineral water (Topo Chico-class) (355 g).
